title: habenaria flava var. virescens
intro: Habenaria flava var. virescens, commonly known as greenish yellow greenhood orchid, is a plant species within the orchid family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria flava var. virescens include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antidiabetic, and antihypertensive effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
